correctness.rationale: The Fourier inversion normalization and idempotence bijection are exact. At nonprimitive times the prime-root minimal polynomial forces uniform CRT marginal sums. At primitive times, a surjective rational map onto the cyclotomic field has kernel dimension p+q-1, exactly the additive CRT matrices; zero-one additive matrices are coordinate cylinders. Uniform row and column sums simultaneously force empty/full by coprimality. Counting constant marginals gives P_{p,q} and Q_{p,q}, cylinder subclasses and the seven disjoint polynomials. All relevant boundary masks are included. The checker at the actual package path independently applies exact cyclotomic long division for all masks of orders 6,10,14,15 and verifies each zero pattern and weight; these checks do not replace the general proof.

originality.rationale: The reviewed claim is the combined seven-class exact zero-set theorem and mask-cardinality generating functions for all cyclic squarefree semiprime orders. Siripuram–Osgood formulate the zero-set problem but prove their general characterization only for prime powers; their concluding discussion identifies composite cases as further work. Lam–Leung Theorem 3.3 already classifies individual primitive-root cancellations, and that classical ingredient is explicitly credited. Neither full text states the joint row/column coprimality exclusion or the seven exact zero-set size polynomials. A published four-point semiprime indicator result concerns one spectral-size layer. The claim is not that semiprime root cancellation itself is new. There remains risk of an equivalent older enumerator.
residual_risks: An earlier cyclic-idempotent sampling or coding-theory table may contain an equivalent exact binomial enumerator under different terminology.

The classical Lam–Leung theorem already covers the primitive-zero ingredient and makes the present joint enumeration derivable with elementary counting; attribution of that ingredient must remain explicit.
The full text of the earlier graph-theoretic interpolation work and of the closest published four-point semiprime record was not available for full-text comparison.

value.rationale: This directly resolves the prescribed-zero enumeration for all squarefree semiprime cyclic convolution idempotents, a natural previously motivated non-prime-power setting, for every frequency support cardinality. It supplies the exact seven-way joint stratification, a cross-prime impossibility of simultaneous nontrivial marginal zeros, and closed exact counting polynomials for spectral sampling projections. It is neither an arbitrary small example nor a one-parameter routine increment of a fixed-support table. The primitive-root cancellation is explicitly credited as classical; the substantive value lies in the complete simultaneous and size-refined classification.
